name: Medical Heating and Cooling Concession
shortDescription: A concession of $291.27 per year for eligible South Australians who need frequent heating or cooling because of a clinically verified medical condition.
plainEnglishSummary: If hot or cold weather severely worsens your medical condition, and you need to use heating or cooling regularly at home, you may be able to receive $291.27 per year toward your energy costs.
audience: South Australians on a low or fixed income
People with a qualifying medical condition that is severely worsened by hot or cold weather
Parents or legal guardians of a child with a qualifying medical condition
People financially responsible for all or part of their household energy bill
supportTypes: Assistance with medically necessary energy costs
Financial support for frequent home heating or cooling
Additional support alongside the Energy Bill Concession
availabilityNote: At the last verification date of 17 August 2026, the concession amount was $291.27 per year. It is indexed each financial year and is available in addition to the Energy Bill Concession. A medical practitioner must help complete and certify the application.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm medical or financial eligibility. Applicants generally need to live at the application address, be financially responsible for part or all of the energy bill, hold an eligible concession card or receive an eligible payment, and have a medical practitioner certify that hot or cold weather severely worsens the qualifying medical condition.
